sents.zh: 上个月，老师带我们去爬山。
sents.en: Last month the teacher took us climbing.

sents.zh: 早上的天气很好，一点也不热。
sents.en: The morning weather was fine, and not hot at all.

sents.zh: 我们八点在学校门口见到。
sents.en: We met at the school gate at eight.
Twenty of us went in all.
The mountain path was long, with trees on both sides.
We walked and talked at the same time.

sents.zh: 走了一个小时以后，我开始觉得累。
sents.en: After an hour I began to feel tired.

sents.zh: 我坐在树下，喝了一些水。
sents.en: I sat under a tree and drank some water.
I said: "I don’t want to walk any more."

sents.zh: 一个朋友走过来，说：“快到了。”
sents.en: A friend came over and said: "We are nearly there."

sents.zh: 他说：“如果现在回去，就看不到上面了。”
sents.en: He said: "If we go back now, we won’t see what is up there."

sents.zh: 我想了想，然后站了起来。
sents.en: I thought about it, then stood up.

sents.zh: 我们又走了半个小时，最后到了山上。
sents.en: We walked another half hour, and at last reached the top.

sents.zh: 从上面看下去，学校小得像一个点。
sents.en: Looking down from up there, the school was as small as a dot.

sents.zh: 虽然很累，但是我很高兴自己没有回去。
sents.en: Although I was tired, I was glad I had not turned back.
